note: Hand-curated subset of techniques relevant to SENTINELX detections. Not a complete ATT&CK catalogue. IDs and names follow MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise; descriptions are short summaries written for this lab.

tactics.name: Initial Access
tactics.description: Getting a foothold into the environment.

tactics.name: Exfiltration
tactics.description: Taking data out of the environment.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.description: Repeated authentication attempts against accounts.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: Guessing passwords for a known account.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
techniques.description: Trying a small set of passwords across many accounts.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Using legitimate credentials to access systems.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
techniques.description: Using a compromised domain account.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Local Accounts
techniques.description: Using a compromised local account.

techniques.name: Create Account
techniques.description: Creating a new account to maintain access.

techniques.name: Account Manipulation
techniques.description: Modifying account properties or permissions.

techniques.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
techniques.description: Exploiting a vulnerability to gain elevated privileges.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Default Accounts
techniques.description: Using default or built-in accounts.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: Executing commands through interpreters such as PowerShell or bash.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
techniques.description: Abusing PowerShell to execute code.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
techniques.description: Using cmd.exe to execute commands.

techniques.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
techniques.description: Transferring tools into the compromised environment.

techniques.name: User Execution
techniques.description: Relying on a user to run malicious code.

techniques.name: Remote Services
techniques.description: Using remote services such as RDP or SMB to move laterally.

techniques.name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
techniques.description: Using RDP for lateral movement.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.description: Using standard protocols for command and control traffic.

techniques.name: Non-Standard Port
techniques.description: Communicating over unexpected ports.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Sending collected data over the command-and-control channel.

techniques.name: Account Discovery
techniques.description: Enumerating local or domain accounts.

techniques.name: System Network Connections Discovery
techniques.description: Listing network connections and shares.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.description: Collecting data from the local filesystem.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.description: Encrypting data to disrupt availability.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses
techniques.description: Disabling or modifying security controls.

techniques.name: Indicator Removal
techniques.description: Deleting logs or artefacts to hide activity.
